_provenance: Per-stage navigation times published in reportesaproducir/comparativo-julio-agosto.html for the 2026-08-04/05 window. The three stores below were captured on Aug 5 via DevTools trace import (mode: 'trace-import'), which stored only session-level totals — the per-stage breakdown exists nowhere else in the repo, so these published figures are carried forward verbatim rather than recomputed.

_caveats.walmart-cr.search: 0.34s is anomalous — flagged in the original report as a likely trace-capture artifact, not a real measurement.
_caveats.email: The ~1.0s email times across all three stores come from an in-page hash route change on an already-loaded checkout, not a cold navigation. They are not comparable to the July or Aug-11 cold-cache measurements.
